label: Tripo

unit.label: Tripo credits (API and Studio balances are separate)

mesh.note: `make` accepts 2 to 4 images for multiview. Text-to-model suits a connectivity test, not production design.

transports.note: Studio. API-key sign-in does not identify the Studio account; its balance and prices are separate.

quote.how: `make --dry-run --json` reports `generation_credits_estimate`: an offline list-price estimate that leaves out unestimated chain steps and does not verify plan access.

recovery: After a timeout resume with `task watch <id> --download`; after a failed download use `task get <id> --download`. A lost create response stays lost until provider history and balance are reconciled. Do not use `redo` to recover.
notes: Exit code 4 means insufficient credits: stop paid commands and ask the person.
